operators.customDisplayName: Load monthly_precipitations_boston.csv via pd.read_csv (comma delimiter, first row as header, UTF-8 defaults) into a DataFrame for Boston monthly precipitation.
Load monthly_precipitations_chatham.csv via pd.read_csv (comma delimiter, first row as header, UTF-8 defaults) into a DataFrame for Chatham monthly precipitation.
Load monthly_precipitations_amherst.csv via pd.read_csv (comma delimiter, first row as header, UTF-8 defaults) into a DataFrame for Amherst monthly precipitation.
Load monthly_precipitations_ashburnham.csv via pd.read_csv (comma delimiter, first row as header, UTF-8 defaults) into a DataFrame for Ashburnham monthly precipitation.

Compute total rainfall for June+July+August in year 2020 for each region (Boston, Chatham, Amherst, Ashburnham): filter rows where Year==2020 (numeric-coerced), coerce Jun/Jul/Aug values to numeric treating 'M'/non-numeric as NA, sum Jun+Jul+Aug per region into jja2020Rainfall, then sort descending by jja2020Rainfall (tie-break by region) and return the ranked table.
